svg.title: The Flisk ecosystem: bring your app, run it with flisk up, export it, watch it run
svg.desc: Bring an app in Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, JVM, Ruby or PHP, from a Compose file, a Tiltfile, a Dockerfile or any image. Flisk runs 77 building blocks: 5 languages, 10 web frameworks, 10 API frameworks, 10 resource types, 8 data and AI services, 23 MCP tools and 11 starter projects. Export writes render.yaml and wrangler.toml and never deploys. A radar finds and checks every running part.
svg.text: $ flisk up · hot reload · one URL · Docker optional
